## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed 158 captures during January 2022. Activity proceeded in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the scheduled activity, and the available sessions were used to support the month’s work.

The capture total provides the activity measure for the site during January 2022. This report records the completed work and the associated image-quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the total of 158 captures completed by East City Eye Clinic. The image-quality outcome is reported separately from the grading outcome to distinguish captures that could not be graded from those that produced a referable result.

## Grading

A total of 38 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 17 days. This is the median time associated with grading during January 2022. The activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a concise operational summary for East City Eye Clinic.
